popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus makes Philonoe (Phylonoe) daughter of Iobates the bride Iobates gives Bellerophon after the Chimera, the Solymi, and the Amazons — the Lycian princess who mothers Isander, Hippolochus, and Laodamia.

popCulture.title: Philonoe
popCulture.description: Daughter of Iobates, wife of Bellerophon — carefully distinct from Phylonoe daughter of Tyndareus whom Artemis makes immortal.

popCulture.title: Bellerophon
popCulture.description: Philonoe's husband — the Pegasus-rider whose Lycian marriage is the reward after surviving Iobates' lethal tasks.

popCulture.title: Iobates
popCulture.description: Philonoe's father — the king who first tries to kill Bellerophon, then marries him to his daughter and shares the kingdom.
